'''Harll''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Farghul/Legends|Farghul]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and a member of the [[Crimson Nova]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We are equal in weapons! So all that remains is&mdash;whose will for death is greater!|Harll, to Mace Windu|<ref name="Republic 66">[[Republic 66|''Republic'' 66]]</ref>}}
[[File:TheDeathofHarll.jpg|thumb|left|Mace Windu kills Harll.]]

Harll was a fierce warrior who often preferred to fight rather than think. Because of his warrior nature, he managed to obtain a [[Sword/Legends|sword]] with a [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] alloy blade as a gift from a [[Morgukai]] warrior.

Eventually, he became romantically associated with the [[Farghul/Legends|Farghul]], [[Mika (Farghul)|Mika]], and joined her [[Crimson Nova|chapter]] of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. This chapter stood out from others for their willingness to accept a contracts on [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] bounties; this eventually attracted the attention of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] who [[Mission to the Rig|sent]] four [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] to deal with the Chapter. When these Masters arrived, Harll used his cortosis sword to fight [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] in a duel that would ultimately lead to Harll's [[Death/Legends|death]].

The Jedi soon overtook the bounty hunter's [[The Rig|headquarters]] and forced the contract to be canceled.

==Behind the scenes==
When Harll's name is first spoken in ''Show of Force'', it is misspelled "Harrll".
